fusions.name: Tireless Fling
fusions.desc: Throws a hatchet that deals 8 damage. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Ridden-In Sweep
fusions.desc: A wheeling sweep that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocks them back 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 6% per 100 paces run since you last used it (max +30%).

fusions.name: Second Wind
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Ride On Past
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 10 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
